intent: 赛博朋克雨夜氛围：密集的雨丝落下，青色与品红的霓虹色调，偶发轻微的故障闪烁

iterations.critique: Palette bug: the R<->B channel swap runs AFTER the Tint, converting the neon cyan into olive-yellow specks on plum — the cyberpunk grade is gone (planner error: swap composes with the grade). Rain also reads as dot specks, not streaks (motion blur alone too subtle at size 2). Density and mood-darkness are fine.

Palette restored — teal-cyan specks on plum-violet, both neon hues present, moody and cohesive. But the core '密集雨丝' still fails: drops render as star-like dots; aspect 5 produced no visible vertical elongation (direction of the ratio may be inverted, or it needs size to show). Wave-warp displacement is present but sub-perceptual at dot scale.

Best of the three: neon teal-on-plum grade cohesive and moody, dense falling field, slight smears on some particles — but the drops still read as dots, not 雨丝 streaks. Aspect ratio (0524) produced no clear elongation in either direction at this scale; motion-blur smear stays sub-perceptual. Max-iters reached. Residue is a rendering-class finding: the streak read needs an aspect/orientation probe (0524 semantics unresolved) or the streaklet/motion-blur mode combination the vendor rain thumbs use.
